Definition: probably remotely from G906 (as a depository); a pouch (for money):--bag, purse.
BiblicalUsage: A balantion is a money bag, a pouch for carrying coins, and Jesus tells the seventy to carry no purse on their mission, then later asks them whether they lacked anything when they went without one.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the empty purse was the lesson: the men who carried nothing found they lacked nothing, because the Lord who sent them provided for them.
